Synthetic example population

Source: R/data.R
example_people.Rd

A synthetic person-level dataset used to demonstrate the costcomorbidity package. The data do not represent real individuals.

Usage

example_people

Format

A data frame with one row per synthetic person and four variables:

id

Synthetic person identifier.

index_date

Start date of the prediction year.

age

Age in years at the index date.

sex

Synthetic sex variable.

Source

Synthetic data generated for the costcomorbidity package.

Details

ICD-10 diagnoses and ATC prescription records for these individuals are available in [example_codes]. One individual deliberately has no code records.
